linearized_metric_carleson: (Theorem 1.1.2) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$ be a function. Assume given an instance of the structure $\mathrm{KernelProofData}\,a\,K$ (the data common to chapters 2–7 of the project); among its fields it provides a doubling-measure structure $\mathrm{DoublingMeasure}\,X\,(2^a)$ on $X$ — whose measure we denote by $\mu$ — and a compatible-functions structure $\mathrm{CompatibleFunctions}\,\mathbb R\,X\,(2^a)$, which provides the type $\Theta(X)$ of continuous functions $X\to\mathbb R$ used below. Assume moreover that $\Theta(X)$ is $\tau$-cancellative with $\tau=1/a$, i.e. $\mathrm{IsCancellative}\,X\,(1/a)$ holds. Let $Q : X \to \Theta(X)$ be a simple function. Let $q, q'$ be nonnegative reals with $1<q\le 2$ and $q'$ the Hölder conjugate of $q$ (i.e. $1/q+1/q'=1$), let $F,G\subseteq X$ be measurable sets, and let $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be measurable with $|f(x)|\le\mathbf 1_F(x)$ for all $x\in X$. For $\theta\in\Theta(X)$ let $T_Q^\theta$ be the linearized nontangential operator, $T_Q^\theta g(x)=\sup_{R_2\in\mathbb R}\ \sup_{0<R_1<R_2}\ \sup_{x'\in B(x,R_1)}\big\|\int_{A(x')}K(x',y)g(y)\,d\mu(y)\big\|_e\in[0,\infty]$, where $A(x')$ is the open annulus centered at $x'$ with radii $R_1$ and $\min(R_2,\mathrm{upperRadius}(Q,\theta,x'))$ (with $\mathrm{upperRadius}$ the project function of that name). Assume that for every $\theta\in\Theta(X)$, $T_Q^\theta$ has bounded strong type $(2,2)$ with respect to $\mu$ and $\mu$ with constant $C_{Ts}(a)=2^{a^3}$, meaning: for every function $g:X\to\mathbb C$ that is bounded with finite-measure support, $T_Q^\theta g$ is a.e. strongly measurable and $\|T_Q^\theta g\|_{L^2(\mu)}\le 2^{a^3}\|g\|_{L^2(\mu)}$. Let $T_Q$ be the linearized Carleson operator, $T_Qf(x)=\sup_{0<R_1<R_2}\|\mathrm{carlesonOperatorIntegrand}(K,Q(x),R_1,R_2,f,x)\|_e\in[0,\infty]$ (with $\mathrm{carlesonOperatorIntegrand}$ the project function of that name). Then $$\int_G T_{Q}f(x)\,d\mu(x)\le C_{1.0.2}(a,q)\,\mu(G)^{1/q'}\,\mu(F)^{1/q},$$ where $C_{1.0.2}(a,q)=2^{(3\mathfrak c+18+5\lfloor\mathfrak c/4\rfloor)a^3}/(q-1)^6$ (a nonnegative real) with $\mathfrak c$ the project's fixed natural-number constant $𝕔$ (fixed equal to $100$ per its docstring).
